headline: Walmart Tops Q3 Estimates and Raises Annual Sales Forecast
summary: Walmart reported third-quarter sales and profit above Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year guidance for the third time this year. Growth was driven by market share gains across diverse consumer income groups.
why: Walmart is the largest retail store chain in the United States and serves as a primary barometer for global consumer spending and retail health.

impacts.name: Walmart Inc.
impacts.why: Quarterly earnings beat expectations alongside a third consecutive boost to full-year guidance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong revenue growth and elevated full-year outlook demonstrated resilient retail volume despite persistent price pressures.
